name: @gjsify/gamepad-native
description: SDL3's gamepad subsystem, statically linked and trimmed, behind a GObject API that speaks the W3C standard layout — the backend of @gjsify/gamepad (ADR 0075). Contains no JavaScript; the prebuilt library and typelib arrive through per-target optionalDependencies.

osNotes.linux: Not built for Linux yet. ADR 0075 Amendment 1 makes this shim the gamepad backend on every OS; its Linux leg is open work, and until it lands and is compared against libmanette, @gjsify/gamepad uses gi://Manette there.
osNotes.darwin: Builds, loads and enumerates on macOS 15+ with only system frameworks and the host GLib as runtime dependencies (measured on arm64; darwin-x64 is built by CI). Input from a real controller has not been verified yet (ADR 0075 stage 4).
osNotes.win32: Not built for Windows yet. The same C source is meant to build there as @gjsify/gamepad-native-win32-x64 (ADR 0075 Amendment 1, ADR 0073's per-package shape); until it does, @gjsify/gamepad has no backend on Windows.

scripts.build:meson: gjsify run init:meson && meson compile -C build
scripts.test: echo 'native only — see test:meson (runs on the macOS prebuild leg)'
